baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exception construction "except what Allah wills" is immediately followed by the reason-like assertion that He knows the overt and whatever hides.
baseline_models.mechanism: Willing selects or brings about a knowable thing, while knowledge spans both public disclosure and concealment. The exception therefore marks a volitional boundary inside a complete epistemic field, not an item escaping knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing supplies the selecting agency of the exception and may include bringing the selected thing about.
The fixed divine name identifies the willing and knowing subject rather than leaving the exception impersonal.
A thing becoming clear to a knower supplies comprehensive apprehension as the frame around the exception.
Open declaration and raised voice supply the publicly available pole of what is known.
Covering and secrecy supply the inaccessible-to-others pole that remains equally within knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The exception can sound like an unexplained interruption, followed by a generic statement of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The knowledge clause constrains how the exception is heard: willing operates with no blind side across both disclosure and concealment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object pair is not merely "the visible and the hidden": one term can name acts of making apparent, while the other is the verbal "whatever hides."
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch inventories make manifestation reversible and graded. Water can be cleared into appearance, a cover can be removed, and a concealed flash can glimmer without becoming fully public. Knowledge thus reaches the transitions by which something hides, leaks through, or becomes manifest.

activation_trace.role: Cleaning a well until its water appears turns overt presence into the result of a material disclosure process.
Removing a cover shows that the concealment root itself can carry the reversal from hidden to exposed.
A faint flash within cloud supplies an intermediate state that is neither fully concealed nor fully manifest.
Knowing as disclosure to the knower gathers every stage of the visibility gradient into one apprehension.

changed_reading.before: The verse divides objects into two static bins, public and hidden.
changed_reading.after: The verse also knows a moving threshold: concealment, partial glimmer, extraction, and full disclosure are all already apprehended.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "He knows the overt and whatever hides" joins a knowledge root that can denote a guiding mark to outward appearance and covered interiors.
baseline_models.mechanism: An outward mark can identify and guide toward something not itself present to view. The overt/hidden pair can therefore be read semiotically: public signs and the concealed realities to which they point are both known, without knowledge being reduced to inference from the sign.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides to a thing supplies the relation between an available sign and an absent referent.
Plain appearance to the eye supplies the publicly legible surface of the sign relation.
Covers and inner things supply realities not exhausted by what their outward marks disclose.
The knowable and reportable thing gives the sign a determinate object rather than treating signs as free-floating symbols.

changed_reading.before: Knowing the overt and hidden is an exhaustive inventory of two classes of facts.
changed_reading.after: It can also name direct command of both public evidence and the concealed referents, causes, or interiors that evidence only indicates.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation and guidance lead into bringing pasture out, then transforming it into dark floating residue. This activates the focus pair as phases of a governed material cycle: what was hidden emerges openly, and what flourished openly is darkened, contained, or carried away, all within informed willing.

activation_trace.role: Will toward a thing anchors the context's ordered transformations back in the focus exception.
Water made apparent by clearing supplies a material image for emergence into the open.
Extraction from under cover makes hiddenness a reversible phase rather than a permanent class.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies an ordered beginning rather than accidental appearance.
Managing by estimation and foresight supplies the governing logic of the sequence.
Gentle direction toward a path turns measured capacity into directed development.
Bringing a thing out of concealment explicitly links the growth scene to the focus visibility threshold.
Causing a thing to become another state supplies the reversal from pasture to residue.
Debris floating on a torrent supplies the exposed remnant of a prior living state.
Blackness or red tending to black supplies the obscuring terminal phase of the visible growth.

structural_cues: 87:2-5 repeats the same relative subject and uses tightly linked result clauses, yielding a sequence from formation through emergence to transformation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measurement, guidance, extraction, transformation, floating residue, and darkening; I supply the lifecycle arrow that treats them as successive visibility states governed by informed will. A live alternative is that the clauses enumerate separate powers without making visibility their organizing axis.

changed_reading.before: The overt and hidden are two simultaneous domains surveyed by knowledge.
changed_reading.after: They become stages in a governed cycle of emergence and recession: what is concealed can be brought forth, and what is manifest can be transformed into dark remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation moves gathered language from latent possession into voiced articulation; forgetting removes it from ready access, while ease, reminder, and written sheets preserve routes of recovery. The exception now reads as a divinely governed limit on retention or retrieval, and the knowledge clause spans both audible output and what remains inward or unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing makes the exception an active retention boundary rather than a random lapse.
Complete apprehension prevents human inaccessibility through forgetting from becoming divine inaccessibility.
The voiced consonant supplies a precise phonetic form for the recitation's publicly articulated layer.
Inner and physically covered things supply the latent, unuttered, or temporarily inaccessible layer.
Reading, reciting, and causing recitation provide the concrete operation immediately bounded by the exception.
Loss from remembrance supplies the access failure to which the exception grammatically attaches.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies a facilitated route from latent possession to usable recitation.
Bringing something back after forgetting supplies recovery rather than treating absence from recall as erasure.
The written sheet externalizes language into a durable public support for what memory may not presently surface.
Priority and beginning extend the recitation-memory mechanism backward into earlier textual transmission.

structural_cues: 87:6 immediately precedes the focus exception, while 87:9-10 repeat remembrance and 87:18-19 close with written sheets.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciting, not forgetting, ease, recollection, and written sheets; I infer that overt maps to voiced availability and hidden to latent or inaccessible memory. The live alternative is that the focus contrast remains universally public/private and only the exception, not the knowledge pair, concerns recitation.

changed_reading.before: The exception limits an unspecified divine act, and overt/hidden remain general objects of knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The exception governs recitational retention, while divine knowledge holds together the sounded text, its latent memory, and what may drop from human access without dropping from knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between choosing the near life and the later, better, more lasting one creates two selection regimes. Human preference is pulled toward what is near and presently apparent; the focus attributes divine willing to a knower of both the apparent and concealed, so its selection is not confined by immediacy.

activation_trace.role: Will toward a thing supplies the divine selection term that the later human preference sharpens by contrast.
Full apprehension gives divine selection an epistemic range unavailable to preference governed by nearness.
Plain appearance supplies the currently available pole toward which near-term preference can be biased.
Concealment supplies outcomes not presently available to sight but still included in informed willing.
Preferring one thing by choice supplies the explicit human counterpart to willing.
Nearness supplies the temporal and perceptual bias of the chosen present life.
Deferral to a later time supplies the less immediately apparent alternative.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies a value criterion that can oppose mere nearness.
Duration and persistence supply the longer horizon hidden by present preference.

structural_cues: The adversative opening of 87:16 and the comparative pair in 87:17 explicitly reverse the audience's chosen horizon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine willing, human preferring, nearness, delay, benefit, and persistence; I infer an asymmetry between selection from complete knowledge and selection biased toward present visibility. A live alternative is that the near/later contrast is purely temporal and should not be mapped onto overt/hidden.

changed_reading.before: What Allah wills is an isolated assertion of unrestricted choice.
changed_reading.after: It becomes selection from a horizon that includes concealed and delayed consequences, pointedly unlike preference captured by what is nearest and most apparent.

context_deltas.mechanism: A reminder is publicly uttered, but its benefit is disclosed only in divergent uptake: recollection with reverent fear or active avoidance with misery. The focus knowledge pair now supports a diagnostic reading in which the outward encounter and concealed receptivity are both known.

activation_trace.role: Apprehension of a thing supplies knowledge of the response before it is exhausted by outward behavior.
Public declaration supplies the audible reminder and the response visible in public conduct.
Secrecy and concealment supply inward receptivity or resistance not identical with public exposure.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the public intervention whose effects diverge.
Benefit opposed to harm makes reception functional rather than merely acoustic.
Fear joined with awe supplies one concealed disposition that becomes visible as recollection.
Deliberate distancing and withdrawal supply the contrary outward trajectory.
Wretchedness opposed to felicity gives the avoidance trajectory its evaluative condition.

structural_cues: 87:9 makes benefit conditional, then 87:10-11 presents opposed recipients whose responses reveal different trajectories.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, benefit, awe, withdrawal, and wretchedness; I infer that hiddenness includes pre-behavioral receptivity and that knowledge grounds differentiated uptake. A live alternative is that the hidden object is unrelated to psychology and the sequence only reports later acts.

changed_reading.before: The knowledge clause catalogs public and private facts without a social function.
changed_reading.after: It also reads as knowledge of why one public reminder becomes beneficial recollection in one hearer and active avoidance in another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context frames the focus with glorifying the Lord's name and later remembering that name in prayer. The fixed divine name inside the focus exception becomes part of an invocation circuit: voiced naming is overt, while the devotion, care, and orientation carried by it can remain concealed.

activation_trace.role: The fixed name used in invocation makes the focus occurrence participate in the context's repeated naming.
Raised or public utterance supplies the audible surface of glorification and prayer.
Concealment supplies the unvoiced orientation or devotion that outward naming may carry.
Worship through glorification and prayer starts the invocation circuit.
A name as indication makes vocal naming a sign that points beyond its sound.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supply the relational content invoked by the title Lord.
Mention running on the tongue supplies the later voiced return of the name.
The specified act of worship turns naming into enacted devotion rather than bare sound.

structural_cues: The name of the Lord appears in the opening command and returns with remembrance and prayer in 87:15, enclosing the focus use of the divine name.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies glorification, naming, lordly nurture, spoken mention, and worship; I infer that hiddenness can include inward devotional orientation behind overt invocation. A live alternative is a narrower audible-versus-inaudible speech contrast with no claim about inward sincerity.

changed_reading.before: Allah is only the grammatical subject of willing and knowing.
changed_reading.after: The name also sits inside a repeated invocation pattern, so knowledge of overt and hidden spans the sounded name and the concealed relation enacted through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Name, visible mark, surviving trace, and written page form a chain of externalizations. Each makes an absent or hidden reality publicly legible without being identical to it. This strengthens the focus-only semiotic model: divine knowledge includes signs, what produced them, and what no surviving sign exposes.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides to a thing provides the focus hinge for the context's external signs.
Plain visibility supplies the legible surface shared by mark, trace, and page.
Covered interiors supply causes and referents that remain beyond their external signs.
The non-dominant mapped image of a visible mark that makes a thing known activates the sign mechanism inside the word for name.
A remaining trace that indicates what once was supplies evidence whose cause is absent.
A written sheet supplies deliberate durable inscription rather than an accidental trace.

structural_cues: The repeated name in 87:1 and 87:15, the preference root's trace branches in 87:16, and written sheets in 87:18-19 progressively thicken the sign network.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies name/mark, residual trace, written page, and the focus's guiding-mark branch; I infer that these form one semiotic chain and that hiddenness includes their absent causes or referents. A live alternative is that the mark mapping is accidental to the contextual sense of name and should remain only exploratory support.

changed_reading.before: God knows immediately visible things and separately concealed things.
changed_reading.after: God knows the whole sign relation: public names, marks, traces, and records, plus the realities and histories they reveal only partially.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stillness can resemble death, earth can become alive through rain, growth can increase, and a thing can persist. Against the explicit neither-dies-nor-lives suspension, hiddenness can denote latency rather than mere secrecy, while overt presence is an activated phase. Knowledge spans dormant, active, and suspended modes.

activation_trace.role: Appearance plainly available to perception supplies the activated or manifest phase.
A faint flash held within cloud supplies latent presence that has not become fully public.
Stillness and dormancy resembling sleep or decay blur the boundary between absence and active life.
Earth becoming alive through rain and vegetation supplies activation from a previously dormant state.
Growth and increase supply a process by which latent capacity becomes outwardly realized.
Persistence supplies continuity across changing degrees of manifestation.

structural_cues: 87:13 coordinates two negations, neither dying nor living, before 87:14 and 87:17 introduce growth and persistence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies suspended life/death, dormancy-like stillness, revived earth, growth, and persistence; I infer a latent/active spectrum behind overt/hidden. A live alternative is that these context states concern punishment and flourishing without altering the semantic range of hiddenness.

changed_reading.before: Whatever hides is simply secret or spatially covered.
changed_reading.after: Whatever hides may include dormant capacity, suspended process, or faintly present life that has not yet crossed into open manifestation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the rare listening branch of the will root with the technical voiced-consonant branch of overt speech. It remains anchored in the focus forms and is activated by the immediate recitation/forgetting sequence, but downstream prose should present it as a phonetic-memory analogy, not replace the ordinary senses of willing and publicity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places a will-root form beside knowledge of al-jahr and what remains hidden; the preceding recitation scene can activate both attentive listening and voiced articulation.

activation_trace.role: Listening closely supplies an auditory shadow around the will-root form without displacing its grammatical sense of willing.
The voiced consonant supplies the articulated acoustic stream that can be heard and retained.
An inner covered thing supplies the silent memory buffer from which articulation emerges.
Causing recitation supplies the live speech event that activates the auditory branches.
Loss from remembrance supplies the possible break between inner retention and voiced output.

changed_reading.before: The memory reading contrasts recited sound with material that is merely absent from recall.
changed_reading.after: A narrower phonetic reading appears: attentive reception, an inward retention buffer, and voiced articulation are all known across the exception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant coercive branch of the will root and the unusual unknown-terrain branch of al-jahr. It remains anchored through the focus's willing, guiding-mark, overt, and hidden roots and gains a coherent route sequence from context; render it as a spatial analogy for guidance, not a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Will, a guiding mark within the knowledge root, traversing unknown land within al-jahr, and concealment can combine into a route-governance model.

activation_trace.role: Driving something toward a matter supplies route propulsion as an exploratory shadow of willing.
A landmark that guides to a thing supplies orientation within the route.
Traversing land without prior knowledge supplies the exposed but epistemically unfamiliar terrain.
Concealment supplies unseen portions and consequences along the route.
Gentle direction to the path supplies guidance rather than mere force.
Lightness and compliance in movement supply facilitated travel.
Leading something to the side supplies the divergent avoidance route.
Following a predecessor's trace supplies route continuity through evidence left behind.
Return to an outcome supplies the route's terminal horizon.

changed_reading.before: The focus asserts static will and static knowledge over visible and hidden objects.
changed_reading.after: It can cast a route: propulsion, landmarks, exposed but unfamiliar ground, concealed stretches, side paths, traces, and final outcome are all under one guiding knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because al-jahr usually strengthens accessibility, while its eye-in-sunlight branch makes excessive manifestation disabling. It remains directly anchored in the focus root and is reinforced by contextual height and fire/light; downstream prose should qualify the glare mechanism as a reversal of human visibility, not as the verse's primary lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus contrasts al-jahr with what hides, but one al-jahr branch describes an eye overwhelmed by sunlight, making the supposedly manifest pole itself hard to perceive.

activation_trace.role: An eye overcome or dazzled by sunlight makes excessive visibility function like concealment for a human observer.
Ordinary covering supplies the opposite route to inaccessibility, allowing glare and concealment to converge in effect.
Knowledge as clear apprehension belongs to the divine subject despite both human perceptual failures.
The upper direction supplies the elevated source-zone conventionally associated with overpowering light.
Light and illumination activate the perceptual excess latent in the al-jahr eye branch.

changed_reading.before: What is overt is easy to know, while only concealment creates an epistemic obstacle.
changed_reading.after: Human access can fail at both extremes, through cover or through overwhelming disclosure; divine knowing is not organized by that human visibility hierarchy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the visibility pair through well-cleaning, floating scum, containment, and liquid thickening. It remains anchored in the focus's own disclosure/revelation branches and in the context's material sequence, but downstream prose should preserve it only as a process analogy for disclosure and remainder.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The al-jahr branch of clearing a well and the khafiya branch of removing a cover permit a material separation model inside the focus pair.

activation_trace.role: Removing mud until well water appears supplies clarified output as the overt pole.
Extraction from beneath cover supplies the separating action between hidden material and exposed result.
Bringing something out of concealment extends the extraction mechanism into the context.
Floating torrent debris supplies a visible residue separated from what the flow carries.
Gathering and containment supply the retained material that does not simply vanish when clarification occurs.
Liquid thickening and congealing at its outcome supplies a late material reversal from flow to settled remainder.

changed_reading.before: Overt and hidden denote only informational states.
changed_reading.after: They can be imagined as outputs of separation: clarified appearance, extracted matter, floating residue, contained remainder, and later settling are all known through the process.

strongest_changes: The immediate recitation and forgetting sequence revises the exception into a governed retention boundary and makes overt/hidden resonate as voiced output versus latent memory.
The creation-to-dark-residue sequence turns manifestation and concealment into reversible phases of emergence, transformation, and recession.
The near-versus-later preference contrast makes divine willing selection from complete knowledge coexist with human selection biased toward present appearance.
Names, visible marks, surviving traces, and written pages strengthen a semiotic reading in which both public evidence and concealed referents are directly known.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories destabilize their own apparent binary: al-jahr can clear a well, traverse unknown land, or blind through sunlight, while khafiya can remove a cover or glimmer from within cloud. Context then activates memory, ecology, reception, ritual, temporality, and material processing without forcing those mechanisms into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains open whether "whatever hides" is best activated as latent memory, concealed receptivity, dormant process, or the unrestricted hidden domain; several mechanisms can coexist without lexical disambiguation.
The contrast between human preference and divine willing is structurally strong but the mapping of near/later onto overt/hidden is reader-supplied.
The listening, route, glare, and material-separation branches are traceable but form- or domain-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
